metadata.text: These doubts arose chiefly from thinking on some passages of scripture ; particularly, the lat- ter part of the second Psaim, where kings who set themselves against the Lord^ and against his Jnointed, are positively commanded to kiss the Son : also, the preaching of John the Baptist, Christ, and his apostles; who, he found, did not hesitate to address unconverted shmers ; and that, in the most pointed manner : saying, Re^ient^ for the kingdom of heaven is at hand. — Refient^ and be converted^ that your sins may be blotted out.
